topic: ADHD: the full picture, lookalikes (companion Reel, off grid)
caption:
Trouble focusing is not always ADHD.

Sleep, stress, mood, thyroid problems and some medicines can all affect attention. Anxiety, low mood and trauma can also sit alongside ADHD rather than instead of it, which is why a careful assessment checks your sleep and health as well.

The short version of this week's carousel. The full carousel is on our profile. Part of our series, ADHD: the full picture.
